diagnosis: The schema introspection endpoint uses SQLAlchemy inspect() to list all database tables in tenant_schema from the URL path. It does not check if current_user is associated with tenant_schema, allowing any user to discover table names, custom extensions, and database internal architecture of other tenants.
exploit_request:
GET /database/schemas/tenant_aerospace_defense/tables HTTP/1.1
Host: schema.platform.io
Authorization: Bearer <contractor_token>
